cues.en: In the last lecture we worked on the deposit alert email templates.
cues.zh: 上一堂完成了存款通知郵件範本。

cues.en: Let's now create the email service that will handle the sending of these emails.
cues.zh: 現在建立處理寄送這些郵件的服務。

cues.en: So we're going to go back to our Project Explorer.
Then you're going to go to backend up core.
Then within core we're going to go to services.
Then within services we're going to create a new file that's going to be deposit underscore alert dot pi.
Then we're going to start as usual with our inputs.
As you can see from decimal we're going to input decimal.
Then from datetime we're going to import datetime.
Then from backend.app.co dot emails dot base.
We're going to import the email template.
Then from backend.app.co dot config we're going to import a settings.
Then we can now create the service.
We're going to say class deposit alert email alert email.
That's going to subclass the email template.
Then we're going to pass in the template name.
The template name is deposit underscore alert dot HTML.
Then the template text version that's going to be deposit underscore alert dot txt.
Then the subject that's going to be deposit alert.
Then the function to send the email that's going to be async.
Define send underscore deposit underscore alert.
The function is going to take in the email of type string.
Then the full name of type string.
Then the action that's going to be of type string amount that's of a decimal type.
cues.zh: action 的型別為 str，amount 的型別為 Decimal。

cues.en: Then the account name of type string, then account number of type string, then currency of type string, then description of type string.
cues.zh: account_name、account_number、currency 與 description 的型別都是 str。

cues.en: Then the transaction date that's going to be of date time type.
Then the reference that's going to be string type.
Then the balance that's going to be of a decimal type like that.
Then this function is going to return none.
Then we're going to define the context that is going to be added to our email template.
cues.zh: 接著定義傳入郵件範本的 context。

cues.en: So for context is going to have the full name that's going to be the full name.
Then action.
That's going to be action.
Then the amount that will be amount, then the account name that will be account name, then the account number that will be the account number.
cues.zh: amount 設為 amount，account_name 設為 account_name，account_number 設為 account_number。

cues.en: Then the currency that will be currency then description.
cues.zh: currency 設為 currency，接著 description。

cues.en: That will be description.
Then transaction date.
That's going to be transaction date then reference.
That's going to be the reference.
Then balance that's going to be balance.
Then the site name that's going to be from our settings.
We're going to bring in the site name.
Then the support email that's going to be settings dot support email like that.
Then we can now send the email by saying await deposit alert email dot send email.
cues.zh: 接著 await DepositAlertEmail.send_email，寄送郵件。

cues.en: And to that we can say email to is going to be the email address.
Then the context that's going to be the context that we have defined up above.
cues.zh: context 設為上面定義的 context。

cues.en: Then we can save that file.
That's it for this service.
In the next lecture we shall define the transaction service.
